title: 2027 - Software Engineer Intern, Dublin - 6 Month Internship
description: \*\*This is a 6 month internship starting in January 2027\*\* We’re seeking curious minds like yours to collaborate with full-time engineers and cross functional teammates, learn development standard methodologies, and gain practical software engineering experience. Software engineering interns are fully integrated into software engineering teams across our Product and Technology organization. Interns spend their time pushing production-level code to make lasting contributions across MongoDB’s products and services for our internal teams, external customers, and developer end users. **What We Are Looking For In You (qualifications)** * In the process of receiving a Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Have a foundation in computer science theory, with proficiencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design. * Fluent in any one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Go, C++, Javascript, Node.js - or a comparable object-oriented programming language. * Have a minimum of one semester remaining in university studies after the internship concludes. Graduation date in, Spring 2028 or Summer 2028. * Must be authorized to work in Ireland and provide the Company with copies of all relevant documents, if requested. Company sponsorship may be available for eligible candidates applying for certain roles. What you'll find at MongoDB * Authentic Culture: A workplace where you are encouraged to bring your whole self to work, we believe that Embracing the Power of Differences is the best way to broaden our own perspectives and foster innovation. * Personalized Mentorship: Pair up with an engineering Mentor, a Program Advisor from the Early Talent Recruitment Team, and an Employee Resource Group (ERG) Guide to foster your growth. * Career Coaching Sessions: Access to a tailored training program designed uniquely for interns’ personal and professional development. * Work-Life Harmony: Embrace "Bloom for Interns" with access to mental and physical health benefits, paid time off, free lunch, and more! * Impactful Projects: Contribute to projects where you can Make it Matter - your meaningful work will see the light of day. * Exclusive Networking: Attend "Speaker Series" and "Roundtables" to connect with our executives and departmental leaders. * Vibrant Community: Build connections with fellow interns and join after-work social events, virtual gatherings, and local city activities to create connections and friendships. * Path to Full-Time: A chance to see if MongoDB is where you see yourself long term with the possibility of receiving a full time offer at the end of the internship! MongoDB internships are full-time (40 hours/week). The internship is a fixed term program, the start date will be January 2027 for a duration of 6 months. All interns are considered hybrid employees, designated the "in office" working model and are expected to be in their office location 3-5 days a week. Due to the high volume of applications our Early Talent Recruitment Team receives, it may take up to six weeks to hear back regarding an update on your application status. Our goal is to get back sooner, but we appreciate your patience as our team carefully reviews each application. **About MongoDB** MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world! MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer. *Req ID: 426470*

title: 2027 Winter Co-Ops - Software Development - Demonware (Dublin)
description: **Job Title:** 2027 Winter Co-Ops - Software Development - Demonware (Dublin) **Requisition ID:** R027957 **Job Description:** This role is based onsite at the Demonware Dublin office, **onsite** . **About Demonware** Demonware is a member of the Activision family of studios, partnering with engineers and creatives across AAA game studios to deliver the online and data services that power some of the world’s biggest franchises — including *Call of Duty* and *Crash Bandicoot* . We’re a technology company that values openness and collaboration. We believe the best ideas win, everyone should feel empowered to contribute, and while we take our work seriously, we don’t take ourselves too seriously. At Demonware, you’ll find big-company challenges with a small-company culture. We support millions of concurrent users and work with technologies such as Python, C++, Java, Linux, MySQL, Erlang, and Kubernetes. Our co-op students make real contributions — many see their code running in production within days of joining. Co-op Program Requirements * Currently enrolled in a post-secondary or graduate program * Expected graduation between January 2027 and May 2028 * Available for an 8-month, in-person co-op starting January 2027 * Clear written and verbal communication * Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills * Resume and transcript required * As part of the interview process, candidates will be required to complete an automated coding assessment Specific Role Requirements **Software Engineering** Software Engineering Co-ops have touched many aspects of Demonware. Needs may shift across each team, but co-ops in the past have helped build multiplayer features, develop core backend systems, and design tools for largescale distributed services. They gain hands-on experience working with Kubernetes infrastructure, automation frameworks, and scalable data pipelines. Throughout the co-op, they collaborate in design discussions, perform root cause analysis, and automate workflows to improve reliability, performance, and developer experience. **Requirements:** * Strong knowledge of Python, C++, and/or Java * Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures * Familiarity with Linux and source control (Git preferred) * Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP, UDP, HTTP) **Nice-to-Have Skills:** * Experience with SQL-based databases (MySQL preferred) * Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools for automating build, test, and deployment * Familiarity with Kubernetes * Exposure to security and scalability concepts * Experience building RESTful services or web applications * Clear passion for computer science showcased through personal projects, or extracurricular activities preferred **Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)** Site Reliability Engineering Co-ops maintain and evolve Demonware’s platform while contributing to the design of highly reliable operational architecture. Co-ops ensure services are scalable, maintainable, and built for players worldwide, working closely with cross disciplinary teams throughout the development lifecycle. They also collaborate with experienced engineers across global offices, gaining exposure to high impact, large scale systems engineering. **Requirements:** * Strong knowledge of Python, C++, and/or Java * Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures * Experience with SQL-based databases (MySQL preferred) * Knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP, UDP, HTTP) * Familiarity with Linux and source control (Git preferred) * Scripting experience (Bash, and/or Groovy) * Knowledge of foundational technologies such as TCP/IP and Linux/Unix internals Nice-to-Have Skills * Familiarity with Kubernetes * Multi-platform development experience * Exposure to security and scalability concepts * Experience building RESTful services or web applications How to Stand Out **We Encourage You To Highlight:** * Specific contributions on previous work/projects * Any Linux experience (school, personal, or home projects) * Programming-related hobbies or personal projects * Notable school assignments * Open-source contributions * Links to code repositories, portfolios, or technical blogs Office Perks * Complimentary breakfast, lunch, and drinks from a fully stocked kitchen * BBQs and Lunch & Learns * City-center office location * Vacation allowance * Competitive pay * Free games How to Apply You can apply directly at demonware.net. Applicants will hear back from a recruiter by December 2026. We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! At Activision Blizzard, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply. Our World At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences. We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization. We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up. **Ready to Activate Your Future?** *The videogame industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners.* *We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to* accommodationrequests@activisionblizzard.com *. General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest.*

title: Actuarial Analyst I
description: Title: Actuarial Analyst I Company: Everest International Insurance Job Category: Analytics Job Description: Everest is a leading global reinsurance and insurance organization with extensive product and distribution capabilities, a strong balance sheet, and an innovative culture. Throughout its history, Everest has maintained a disciplined focus on creating long-term value through underwriting excellence and strong risk and capital management. At Everest, the future is shaped by the actions taken today. These actions extend beyond business strategy and encompass the values that are important to employees and the communities in which the company operates. Everest's commitments include providing an inclusive work environment that supports professional development, investing in communities through the donation of time and financial resources, maintaining integrity across all aspects of the organization, and driving innovation to help solve complex global risks. Why Join? Everest Insurance International Wholesale & Specialty (IW&S) is part of a global organization. IW&S consists of Everest Syndicate 2786, Everest Insurance Ireland DAC (EIID), and Everest Insurance Singapore (EIS). This is an exciting time to join IW&S as the business continues to develop and grow its wholesale and specialty portfolio, investing in talent, systems, and capabilities under a global strategy. The Actuarial Function plays a key role in supporting and influencing the business's strategic objectives and long-term ambitions. Significant investment and collaboration across the wider Group are helping establish a best-in-class actuarial function. The structure of IW&S provides the opportunity to make a tangible impact on both the day-to-day operations and the future direction of the actuarial department. The successful candidate will play an important role in shaping strategy, enhancing actuarial capabilities, and strengthening business partnerships across the organization. Role Purpose As a key member of the actuarial function, the successful candidate will support and help drive both business-as-usual activities and strategic initiatives, working collaboratively with colleagues across the actuarial team and wider business. In addition to contributing to the ongoing development of the team's capabilities, the successful candidate will take ownership of key aspects of actuarial processes, stakeholder management, business reporting, and capital management activities. The role will also involve supporting actuarial leadership through analysis that informs key business decisions and company results. This is a broad and varied role offering exposure to a wide network of stakeholders, multiple actuarial disciplines, project initiatives, and quarterly reporting activities. The successful candidate will enjoy a high degree of autonomy within a supportive and collaborative environment. This opportunity is well suited to someone seeking a steep learning curve, ownership of meaningful work, and the ability to make a visible impact on the business. Key Accountabilities * Support the development and calibration of key actuarial assumptions and methodologies. * Assist in the reporting of actuarial results to key stakeholders, Group functions, and regulatory bodies. * Contribute to pricing, reserving, and capital management discussions with underwriting, actuarial, claims, finance, and reinsurance teams to support underwriting performance and business outcomes. * Deliver actuarial analysis that supports the business planning process and communicate findings to internal and external stakeholders. * Collaborate with actuaries, claims professionals, and underwriters to share information, influence decision-making, and gain alignment on actuarial assumptions. * Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements. * Develop tools, reporting capabilities, and analytical outputs that leverage actuarial data to improve underwriting performance and provide meaningful insights to senior management and key stakeholders. * Support the timely delivery and effective communication of actuarial results and recommendations. Professional Experience * Demonstrated ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues and stakeholders. * Bachelor's degree or higher in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Business, or a related discipline. **Skills & Abilities** * Strong technical skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel, SQL, Power BI, and AI-enabled tools. * Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. * Ability to communicate complex modelling processes and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences through presentations, reports, and discussions. * Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. * Flexible, enthusiastic, and proactive approach, with a genuine desire to learn and develop professionally. Competencies * Embrace and demonstrate Everest's Core Values: Collaboration, Thoughtful Assumption of Risk, Execution, Humility, and Leadership. * Uphold Everest's Core Values in all interactions with colleagues, customers, and business partners. * Contribute to a culture of integrity, accountability, and excellence through day-to-day responsibilities and decision-making. Everest's success, and the success of its employees, begins with these values. All employees are expected to support and embody these principles in their interactions with others and throughout their daily work. *What if I don’t meet every requirement? At Everest we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. So, if you are excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every element in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Please let us know if you need any accommodations throughout the application or interview process.* **Our Culture** At Everest, our purpose is to provide the world with protection. We help clients and businesses thrive, fuel global economies, and create sustainable value for our colleagues, shareholders and the communities that we serve. We also pride ourselves on having a unique and inclusive culture which is driven by a unified set of values and behaviors. Click here to learn more about our culture. * Our Values are the guiding principles that inform our decisions, actions and behaviors. They are an expression of our culture and an integral part of how we work: Talent. Thoughtful assumption of risk. Execution. Efficiency. Humility. Leadership. Collaboration. Inclusion and Belonging. * Our Colleague Behaviors define how we operate and interact with each other no matter our location, level or function: Respect everyone. Pursue better. Lead by example. Own our outcomes. Win together. All colleagues are held accountable to upholding and supporting our values and behaviors across the company. This includes day to day interactions with fellow colleagues, and the global communities we serve. Type: Regular Time Type: Full time Primary Location: Dublin, Ireland Additional Locations: Privacy Notice | Everest (everestglobal.com)

title: BIM Technician
description: **Application Deadline:** 16 October 2026 **Department:** BIM **Location:** Dundalk **Description** **Team Overview:** Our BIM (Building Information Modelling) team plays a vital role in delivering accurate, coordinated, and data-rich 3D models for use throughout the design, construction, and installation phases of our projects. Working closely with design engineers, project managers, and site teams, the department ensures that all mechanical and electrical services are fully integrated and clashfree prior to construction. This proactive approach helps reduce risk, improve efficiency, and enhance collaboration across all stakeholders — ultimately supporting the successful delivery of high-quality, bespoke MEP solutions. **Role Overview:** We are looking to appoint a BIM Technician to support the wider BIM and Design teams in developing accurate, coordinated, and information-rich 3D models that facilitate design, offsite manufacture, and onsite installation. This entry-to-intermediate role is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in digital design, prefabrication, and BIM delivery within one of the UK and Ireland’s leading offsite construction specialists. **Job Title** | **BIM Technician** **Location** | **Dundalk, Co. Louth** **Hours** | **Monday-Thursday 8am-5pm and Friday 8am-3pm** **Salary** | **Competitive Depending on Experience** **Responsible to** | **BIM Lead** **What You'll be Doing** The role involves supporting the development and maintenance of 3D Revit MEP models for mechanical and electrical building services, working alongside BIM Coordinators, Engineers, and Project Managers to ensure models are coordinated, accurate, and clash-free. Responsibilities include preparing federated models using Revizto, updating models based on design changes and revisions, producing 2D drawings, fabrication and installation packs, and maintaining accurate information and version control within the CDE. The role also supports fabrication and site teams by providing up-to-date construction information and participating in coordination meetings and model reviews. In addition, the position requires ongoing development of BIM and software skills, including Revit and Revizto, applying ISO 19650-compliant processes, and contributing to improvements in modelling standards and departmental efficiency.

title: Climate Projects Solicitor
description: Our client, a leading Irish commercial law firm, is home to one of the most highly regarded climate law practices in Europe. It has been repeatedly recognised as the top firm for voluntary carbon market work, and with its US affiliate it forms one of the largest dedicated climate law teams in the world. As the practice continues to grow, they’re looking for an ambitious junior solicitor to join them. This isn’t an ESG advisory seat. It’s transactional, cross-border commercial work in one of the fastest-moving areas of law. You’ll advise project developers, investors and corporates on carbon markets, Article 6 of the Paris Agreement, carbon removals, sustainable aviation fuels and climate finance, and you’ll learn directly from a partner widely regarded internationally as a leading authority on voluntary carbon markets. **Key responsibilities** * Draft, review and negotiate carbon credit purchase agreements, ERPAs, pre-purchase, framework supply and offtake agreements * Advise on climate project development, financing, investment and acquisitions, including legal due diligence * Advise on Article 6, CORSIA, the EU ETS and the EU Carbon Removal and Carbon Farming Certification Framework, including host country authorisation processes * Prepare client memos, regulatory briefings, board papers and thought leadership on a fast-evolving policy landscape * Get involved early in client relationships, business development, industry working groups and conferences **The person** A solicitor qualified in Ireland and/or England & Wales, NQ to 3 PQE, from a commercial law firm or an in-house environment. Backgrounds in commercial contracts, corporate, projects, energy, infrastructure, finance, environmental law or ESG all translate well, and postgraduate study in climate or environmental law is welcome, but none of these is essential. What matters most is strong drafting and research skills, clear communication, and a genuine interest in climate change, carbon markets and emerging climate technologies. Reach out to Caitriona Breaw @ Amicus Search & Recruitment to learn more.

title: Commercial Graduate Rotation Program - Commercial Path - German Speaking Market

The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. This exciting **12-month program** is designed to give graduates exposure to both sales and solution engineering. Having built the foundational skills for both roles and met our eligibility criteria, top graduates on this path can begin their **Salesforce Sales** careers. The promotion window opens from **month 7 onwards.** Our graduate program is a fully immersive experience, combining comprehensive learning paths with in-role experience. You will be assigned experienced **Sales Development Buddys** who will provide hands-on coaching, invite you to join their discovery and qualification calls, giving you the confidence to pick up the phone to reach out to your first salesforce customers. You will also be paired with experienced **Solution Engineer Buddies** during the SE Rotation who will involve you in their live deals. Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to senior sales and solution engineering professionals during our inspiration sessions. By joining Salesforce, you will have the opportunity to lay the foundation for a **fast-paced, successful career** . We are a proud member of the **Fortune 100 Best Places to Work** list for the past 14 years and a consistent winner of **Great Place to Work** awards. Who are we looking for? * You are a 2025 or 2026 graduate (minimum bachelor’s degree), ideally in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathmatics, Data Analytics or another science discipline. We also welcome graduates from all other academic backgrounds. * You are interested in the impact technology can have on the world and business * You are a creative problem-solver * You are a relationship builder and possess a growth mindset * You are curious, self-motivated, and focused on continuous learning * You thrive in a team environment * You have excellent interpersonal skills * You are goal-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced environment * You are fluent in English & German is essential What does our EMEA Graduate Program look like? **The Program Is Structured As Follows** Introduction Month During your first month, you will receive extensive onboarding enablement through a Salesforce-style academy, where you will: * Become immersed in the culture of Salesforce and gain a deep understanding of our values * Develop an understanding of our solutions, technologies, and tools * Learn critical professional skills for your career at Salesforce * Follow a structured learning calendar with sessions and hands-on workshops led by experts and program alumni Rotations During the Graduate Program, graduates on both the Sales and Solution Engineering Paths will follow the same curriculum and complete the same rotations. The structure of each rotation is similar: you will spend **60% of your time** immersed in the role with clear tasks, targets, and stakeholder alignment, while the remaining **40%** will focus on role-specific learning. You will be paired with experienced buddies in each path. title: Commis Chef
description: **Company Description** The Hoxton has opened its very first hotel in Ireland in the beautiful capital city of Dublin. This coastal city is steeped in history, packed with green parks and brought to life through music, art and the best social eating and drinking. The Hoxton, Dublin is home to 129 bedrooms of varying sizes, a lobby bar & restaurant, a historic bar, Cantina Valentina, our large ground floor restaurant and The Dig - our unique meetings and events space.. **Job Description** **What you will do…** * Support the kitchen team with the preparation and production of delicious, high-quality dishes. * Learn and develop your skills across different sections of the kitchen, working closely with our senior chefs. * Prepare ingredients to the required standard, including washing, peeling, chopping, portioning and basic cooking. * Follow recipes, preparation lists and instructions to ensure consistency across every dish. * Keep your section clean, organised and fully stocked throughout service. * Work as part of the team during busy services, communicating clearly and helping wherever you’re needed. * Ensure all food is stored, prepared and handled safely, following our food hygiene and safety standards at all times. * Support with deliveries, stock rotation and maintaining a well-organised kitchen. * Minimise waste and make the most of our ingredients while maintaining the quality and integrity of our dishes. * Take pride in every plate that leaves the kitchen, paying attention to presentation, quality and consistency. * Be curious, ask questions and take every opportunity to learn from the chefs around you. * Follow all health, safety and food hygiene procedures and contribute to maintaining a safe working environment. * Bring energy, enthusiasm and a positive attitude to every shift. Qualifications **What We’re Looking For…** * You’re looking for a place where you can be you; no clones in chef whites here. * A genuine passion for food, hospitality and working with fresh ingredients. * A positive attitude and willingness to learn and develop your skills. * You’re not precious. title: DSE & Enablement Healthy Working Advisor
description: **DSE & Enablement Healthy Working Advisor** **Location:** This is a full-time, permanent and office-based position in Dublin. You must be comfortable working on-site daily. **Salary:** €30,000–€38,000 We are recruiting a DSE & Enablement Healthy Working Advisor to join the workplace health and wellbeing team of a major international organisation in Dublin. This is a permanent, full-time position supporting employees with Display Screen Equipment assessments, workplace ergonomics, reasonable adjustments and wider healthy-working requirements. The role suits someone with hands-on DSE assessment experience in a corporate environment who enjoys working directly with employees to resolve workplace comfort, ergonomic, and accessibility issues. You will work with employees who may require additional support due to musculoskeletal concerns, pregnancy, neurodiversity, disability or other health-related requirements, helping identify appropriate workplace adjustments and practical solutions. **What you’ll be doing:** **You will:** * Conduct individual DSE and Healthy Working Assessments * Carry out assessments for high-risk employees and new and expectant mothers * Support employees requiring workplace enablement or reasonable adjustments * Review workstation setups and identify ergonomic risks or areas for improvement * Recommend appropriate ergonomic equipment, furniture and workplace adjustments * Conduct both face-to-face and video-based assessments * Produce clear, accurate assessment reports and document recommendations * Manage follow-up assessments and individual cases through to resolution * Work with HR, Health & Safety, Office Operations and Technology teams where required * Support employees with more complex health, accessibility or neurodiverse requirements * Assist with the organisation's on-site Accessibility Centre * Deliver employee drop-in sessions and guide healthy working practices * Liaise with specialist external providers where additional support is required * Support employees at Dublin offices and occasionally at other Dublin client locations **What we’re looking for:** Ideally, you will have at least one year of practical experience carrying out DSE or Healthy Working Assessments. **You should have:** * Experience conducting DSE/workstation assessments * A good understanding of workplace ergonomics * Knowledge of ergonomic equipment and furniture * An understanding of workplace Health & Safety requirements * Confidence dealing directly with employees, including individuals with more complex health or accessibility needs * Strong written communication and report-writing skills * Good organisational and case-management skills * Confidence working independently and managing your own appointment schedule * Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Teams and related workplace systems Experience using DSE assessment platforms such as Cardinus would be advantageous. Candidates from Physiotherapy, Occupational Health, Occupational Therapy, Ergonomics or similar backgrounds may also be considered where they can demonstrate relevant workplace assessment experience. **Right to Work:** Applicants must already hold the unrestricted right to work in Ireland. Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. **Start Date:** The organisation is looking to appoint as soon as possible, so candidates available at short notice are particularly welcome. If you have experience supporting employees with workplace ergonomics, DSE assessments and healthy-working solutions and would like to join a large international organisation, we would be interested in hearing from you. Contact: Elvis Eckardt

title: Digital Media Executive
description: **Company Description** GrowthStory is a specialist audio and creator agency. We deliver business and brand impact using audio and video first creator media. GrowthStory sits between ambitious brands, agencies & Ireland's most engaging talent. We partner with trusted creators & talent, helping brands connect through storytelling. **Role Description** **We’re growing and we are looking for a Digital Media Executive to support this growth.** GrowthStory and AudioOne are leading digital advertising businesses operating in the paid advertising, audio and creator media areas. **The Role** This is a hands-on role supporting the team and will see you involved in the setup, delivery, optimisation, reporting and measurement of digital media campaigns. You will work alongside experienced Paid Media, Social, Google, Audio and Programmatic specialists and have the opportunity to learn across multiple areas of digital advertising. **What You will Be Doing :** **Campaigns & Delivery** · Set up campaigns across Google, Paid Social, Audio and Programmatic. · Build campaign structures, audiences and targeting. · Complete campaign QA before launch. · Carry out delivery checks once campaigns are live. **Campaign Management** · Monitor campaign delivery, spend and pacing. · Track performance Vs KPIs and targets · Make campaign optimisations. **Reporting & Measurement** · Pull campaign and performance data. · Support weekly and monthly reporting. · Support pixel and conversion tracking. · Identify trends and insights. · Help measure campaigns against business and brand objectives. **Who We are Looking For** · Ambitious, mature and dynamic · Strong work ethic · Curious, analytical and organised, with a genuine desire to learn. · 1–2 years’ experience in digital media, advertising or marketing preferred, but we are open to earlier- career candidates with the right skills and attitude. · A genuine interest in digital advertising and media. · History of working effectively with teams, possessing good communication skills. · Google Ads, Paid Social, GA4 or programmatic experience is helpful, but not essential. **We are much more interested in your attitude, potential and ambition than whether you know every platform on day one.** **What You’ll Learn** Paid Social | Google | Programmatic | Campaign Management | Tracking | GA4 | Reporting | Attribution | Measurement | Optimisation | Audio **Why GrowthStory?** · Join a growing business where you can get involved, learn quickly and make a difference · Work across paid media, audio, creators, podcasts and video · Continuous training and mentoring alongside experienced media professionals and specialists · A brilliant opportunity and on-ramp to a career in the media and marketing industry. **Role Details** **Role:** Digital Media Executive **Location:** Dublin / Hybrid **Salary:** €30,000 depending on experience **Experience:** 1–2 years preferred, but open to earlier-career candidates **Start date:** TBD **Holidays:** 5 weeks **Pension:** Employer contributions **Bonus** – Participation in company bonus scheme **How to Apply** Please send your CV along with a short note telling us about your interest in digital media and why you’d like to join GrowthStory & Audio One.

title: Electrical Engineer
description: **Johnson Controls** **Electrical Engineer** *European Air-Cooled Chiller Engineering | Dublin, Ireland* **What You Will Do** Johnson Controls has an exciting Electrical Engineer opportunity based at our Dublin, Ireland location, supporting our new European air-cooled chiller engineering organization. If you enjoy electrical analysis, detailed design, and control, this could be the right position for you. In this role you will support the electrical performance of air-cooled chiller components and systems engineered for the European market, working under general supervision to complete detailed design work. You will provide support to production, laboratory, service, applications, and marketing teams across Europe, and contribute to new and exciting product development programs while continuing to build your expertise. **How You Will Do It** * Completes detailed design of electrical power panels, control panels, variable speed drives, and wire harnesses in accordance with CE marking requirements and applicable European directives – including the Low Voltage Directive, EMC Directive, and Machinery Directive – and harmonized standards such as EN/IEC 61439 and EN/IEC 60204-1 * Works under general supervision, following work instructions and defined processes to conceptualize and implement design ideas into the product * Defines and plans own activities for a project and completes detailed design work * Writes product specifications, and prepares, checks, and coordinates the release of documentation to support designs * Provides support to application engineers, designers, factory operations, product marketing, and product technical service, and can mentor new hires at the Engineer I level * Reports the status of own work, and that of junior team members, to the project team, with good written and verbal communication * Helps execute test programs to validate the electrical performance and reliability of chiller systems and components; analyzes, modifies, and troubleshoots sub-components based on test data * Contributes to the accurate and on-time completion of projects and regularly reports on the status of assigned work * Selects suitable electrical components, considering cost, performance, and reliability * Continuously increases expertise across chiller electrical design, theory, construction, operation, and applications; participates in process improvement * Uses standard technical and mathematical principles, theories, concepts, and best-practice methodologies in the field * Responsible for engineering drawings, including electrical schematics and bills of materials * Adheres to the Company’s Code of Conduct and Business Ethics standards **Required** **What we look for** * BS in Electrical Engineering or related field * Minimum 2 years of work experience in a related field * Working knowledge of European electrical directives and standards (CE marking, Low Voltage Directive, EMC Directive, Machinery Directive) and harmonized IEC/EN standards * Proficient in electrical design, able to conceptualize and implement design ideas into the product * Able to organize and process large amounts of data * Good written and verbal communication skills * Ability to work in a fast-paced, schedule-driven, team-oriented environment * Ability to travel up to 10%, primarily within Europe **Preferred** * Experience engineering industrial products in engineer-to-order, applied, or made-to-order environments * Understanding of chiller controls and variable speed drives (VSDs) * Familiarity with HVAC systems and motor-driven mechanical engineering design and test * Experience with product development and sustaining of configurable systems * Experience with ERP / material resource planning (MRP) software * Experience applying European regulatory standards such as EN/IEC 61439, EN/IEC 60204-1, etc.

Together, we strive to improve quality of life while building a more inclusive future

title: Emerging Talent Acquisition Specialist
description: PTSB is one of Ireland's leading retail and SME banks, with an innovative range of products and services powered through an evolving digital landscape, our focus is centred on ensuring we deliver what our customers, colleagues and communities need to be successful. At PTSB we believe that emerging talent and entry level recruitment plays a vital part in supporting the Bank's growth strategy, build future leaders and help us create a more diverse community of colleagues. As the Emerging Talent Acquisition Specialist you will design and manage the Emerging Talent Initiatives and work with the wider Talent Acquisition team to attract and select high quality candidates into our Emerging Talent roles while assisting other recruitment initiatives that support our DEI strategy. This is an exciting opportunity to be involved in a highly vibrant environment and to be part of innovative approaches to finding and developing great people for PTSB. You will work in partnership with Hiring Managers, the Talent Team and third party providers where needed. You will ensure a top class experience for candidates and business leaders through the full recruitment cycle. **Responsibilities:** **Emerging Talent Acquisition** * Build out our Campus recruitment strategy for Graduate recruitment, Internships, apprenticeships, transition year, CoOps and placements * Develop and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including universities and schools * Provide high quality design and administration of Emerging Talent Campaigns and programmes, ensuring PTSB is keeping up to date with the ET market trends **HR Talent Team Collaboration** * In partnership with the Talent and Resourcing Manager, contribute with the design, plan and implementation of our Emerging Talent Recruitment strategy * Track, report and maintain the recruiting system updated with a high level of integrity and accuracy * Provide market information, recruitment best practice and insights to the Recruitment Team and hiring managers **Governance and Risk Management** * Keep up-to-date with all relevant recruitment/HR legislation and support processes to ensure Talent Acquisition is fully compliant * Review and challenge the talent acquisition governance processes including risk event reporting, annual policy review * Ensure high quality standards in recruitment for all roles, * Liaise with HR Operations to ensure contracts of employment are issued and pre-employment checks are completed for new hires **Requirements:** **Essential** * Must have a passion for identifying talent, sourcing, screening and placing candidates with a strong emphasis on top quality hiring * Good knowledge of talent analytics and their use in the Talent Acquisition environment * Ability to advise hiring managers on developing a world class emerging talent sourcing strategy for the different business areas * Have strong consulting skills and the ability to work in a team environment sharing best practice with changing priorities and time pressures **Desired** * Previous experience working in the Emerging Talent/Graduate Recruitment/Campus Recruitment space * Third level degree in Human Resources or Business related discipline * Ideally have or working towards CIPD / formal Recruitment Qualification CIPD/Recruitment * End to end recruitment / assessment process including competency / behavioural based assessment techniques **This is a permanent position, based in PTSB Head Office, St. Stephen's Green, Dublin (Hybrid option available within the Republic of Ireland only)** Is this you? Please apply online on our website or via the apply link of this role. Your application will be sent through to our Talent Acquisition team and they will be in touch regarding your application. We reserve the right to draw up a shortlist for interview. The Bank understands the importance of a consistent and relentless focus on championing diversity and inclusion. We aim to attract, recruit, and retain individuals with diverse backgrounds, skills, competencies and abilities to work collaboratively to enhance the service we provide to all of our customers and the communities we serve.

title: Employment Advisor
description: Due to our continuing success in the National Employment service we are currently recruiting for an Employment Adviser to join our fantastic team in an exciting opportunity to make a real difference in this influential role. You can become an Employment Adviser if you have excellent customer service skills gained from having a sales, recruitment or hospitality background or have worked in an environment that involves advising and guidance. We do provide excellent on the job training, so are not looking for someone who ticks every single box, we’re looking for someone who has an engaging personality, can provide a warm and welcoming experience, and can seek out solutions to problems to help our customers progress into sustainable employment. This is a fantastic opportunity that will allow you to utilise your current skills to influence, support and encourage others to build a future. Employment Advisers provide motivational support, careers advice and guidance to our clients whilst making them feel welcome and at ease, enabling them to overcome barriers and build confidence. They provide training workshops covering a wide range of subjects from CV writing to online job searching. They engage with people to assess their skills and abilities and talk about their ambitions and career goals whilst exploring learning and work opportunities acting as an intermediary with local employers. In return for your dedication, knowledge, and commitment, we’re offering a competitive salary of **€30,000 p.a. plus Dublin Allowance** with these great benefits: **• 25 days annual leave + Bank Holidays + Birthday Day off (with the opportunity to buy additional days)** **• Volunteer Days** **• Company Pension Scheme** **• Health Insurance Allowance** **• Employer Paid Healthcare Cash Plan, incl. 3 x salary life assurance** **• Annual Salary Review** **• Enhanced Maternity/Adoption and Paternity Pay Arrangements** **• Refer a friend scheme** **• Free access to BenefitHub – an online portal with access to a wide range of retail discounts, Life assurance, Cycle to Work scheme, Tax Saver Commuter Tickets, Digital Gym Membership** There’s also the opportunity to progress your career! **Interested?** There’s an easy to apply route below to upload your CV! If you need any further information, talk to our experienced Internal Recruitment Team on +44 1702 595200 or 01- 8608200. We are an employee-owned organisation, and we continually pride ourselves on our sense of community, both in the incredible work we do throughout UK and Ireland, and internally within our employee-owners. People are at the front, centre, and heart of every service we provide and each decision we make. **Location:** Swords **Contract** : Permanent **Hours** : 37.5 hours per week – 8:30am to 5:00pm Monday to Friday (full time) **Closing Date:** 22 October 2026 **Key Responsibilities** • Assess client’s specific needs providing support, careers advice and guidance, and work with them to create a personal progression plan. • Work with clients using a variety of strategies to support development, enabling them to overcome barriers and build confidence. • Provide training workshops covering a wide range from CV writing to online job searching. • Explore learning and work opportunities, acting as an intermediary with local employers. • Meet with clients regularly to review their progress. • Deliver an exceptional level of customer service at all times. **Skills and Experience** • Leaving Certificate standard (as a minimum). A third level degree is desirable but not a pre-requisite. • Minimum of one year experience in a recruitment, sales, training and/or customer facing role. • Experience of working in a target orientated environment. • Ability to multi-task, organise and manage workload. • Positive, enthusiastic approach to problem solving with a ‘can do attitude’. • Be fully IT literate in using a range of Microsoft Office programmes. **Additional Information** We deliver Employability services across Ireland through various Government contracts (Department of Social protection) to assist the long term unemployed in returning to the workforce through upskilling and job brokering. Working with over 10,000 Irish businesses and employers, Seetec has helped over 45,000 people into work in Ireland to date. The company directly employs over 120 people in Ireland working in locations across Ireland primarily in Dublin, Louth, Meath, Athlone, Longford, Mullingar, Galway and Mayo. Seetec is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of young people and vulnerable adults and expects all staff to share and uphold this commitment in conjunction with the requirements of the Prevent Duty and the positive promotion of modern values. Seetec is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.

title: Entry-Level English Teacher
description: Are you a recent graduate with a **bachelor’s degree** , or are you about to finish your degree and looking for an **entry-level** opportunity? Are you a career changer, taking a gap year, or an experienced ESL teacher? Do you want to **teach English** abroad, explore Asia, and develop your professional skills? Whether you're a certified ESL/TEFL teacher, a recent university graduate looking for your **first entry level job after graduation** , or simply someone ready for a life-changing move overseas, this is your entry point into international teaching. We will provide you with full support and training. **What you'll do** - Teach English to young learners aged 3–16 in a fun, interactive, and immersive classroom setting. - Deliver high-energy lessons using English 1’s award-winning curriculum and digital tools. - Provide constructive feedback and help students build confidence in their English skills. - Take part in school events, cultural activities, and student engagement programs. **What you’ll get** * Competitive salary + performance bonus (after 6 months) * 21 days paid leave (10 paid days + 11 statutory holidays) * Flight allowance * International health insurance (co-paid) * Airport pick-up support * Fully sponsored legal Z work visa + up to 2 weeks sponsored hotel stay * Comprehensive training and ready-made teaching materials * Free TEFL certification + ongoing professional development * Distance learning opportunities (Level 6 Trinity College CertPT, DELTM) * Free Mandarin lessons and English 1–organized cultural activities *\*The hotel accommodation for the first two weeks will be deemed as a sponsorship upon successful completion of the first-year contract.* *\*Sponsored legal Z work visa expenses will be reimbursed.* **Who we’re looking for** - A bachelor’s degree (in any subject) - A valid passport - A genuine interest in education, travel, and cultural exchange. - ESL certification (TEFL, TESOL, CELTA) is a plus- we can sponsor - Clean background check. **Why Teach with English 1?** With over 30 years of success, 200+ schools, and a strong presence across China and Indonesia, English 1 is a trusted leader in English education. Our teachers are at the heart of everything we do. We provide **structured support, professional growth, and a welcoming international team** —so you can focus on what you do best: teaching. #EntryLevelJobs #GraduateJobs #CareerChange #TEFL #TESOL #GapYearJobs #OpenToWork

title: Expression of Interest - Water
description: **Job Description** **What if you could shape a career as unique as you?** **Shape the future of water with us.** With our newly opened Dublin office and established office in Naas, we’re growing our Water team in Ireland. We’re keen to connect with people who want to help shape that growth, tackle meaningful water challenges and build a career supported by local colleagues and global expertise. **A Little More About Our Water Business...** Our Water business brings together engineering, environmental, advisory and digital expertise to help create resilient, sustainable water futures. From clean water and wastewater infrastructure to flood resilience and sustainable water management, our multidisciplinary teams help clients respond to climate change, growing demand and complex environmental challenges. Together, we develop solutions that make a lasting difference to communities and the environment. **Why register your interest?** As we develop our Water team in Ireland, we’re inviting expressions of interest for current and future opportunities across Dublin and Naas. Whether you’re looking to deepen your technical expertise, lead projects or help develop a growing team, we’d welcome the opportunity to understand your experience and career ambitions. This is an expression of interest rather than an application for a specific vacancy. We’ll consider how your skills and interests align with opportunities as they arise. **Where you could fit** **We’re interested in hearing from people across a range of disciplines, including:** * Asset Design: Civil, Mechanical, Process and Electrical, Instrumentation, Control and Automation (EICA) Engineering, and Project Management. * Asset Consulting: Wastewater Modelling, Clean Water Modelling and Network Analysis. * Sustainable Water Management: Flood Risk, Hydraulic Modelling, Infrastructure and Sustainable Drainage, Hydrology, Hydrogeology, River and Coastal Engineering, and Environmental Assessment, including EIA. We welcome interest from people at different stages of their careers, from developing professionals to experienced specialists and leaders. **What You Can Expect At WSP** * The opportunity to help shape our growing Water team in Ireland. * Meaningful work focused on communities, infrastructure and the environment. * Collaboration with multidisciplinary colleagues and access to global expertise. * Opportunities to develop through technical progression, project delivery or leadership. * Flexible ways of working and a focus on innovation, digital capability and sustainable solutions. **Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.** Tell us about your experience, your preferred location and what you’re looking for next. **With us, you can. Register your interest today.** **About Us** We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?** **Work-life balance** At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community. Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK. **Inclusivity & Belonging** We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity. **Health & Wellbeing** We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme. Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package. **Flex your time** To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day. We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you. **Your development** We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership. **#WeAreWSP** *Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.*

title: Fellow in Perinatal Genetics and Genomics
description: The National Maternity Hospital (NMH) is seeking applications from suitability qualified persons for the post of Fellow in Perinatal Genetics and Genomics. This is a 1-year full time fellow post based at the NMH. This role will report to the Head of department, Prenatal Clinical Genetics and Genomics. The ideal candidate will hold a Medical degree and will have completed their training in Obstetrics and Gynaecology. An MSc along with demonstrable evidence of an interest in genetics are desirable. **Skills and Abilities:** phlebotomy, good communication skills, ability to work as part of an MDT and liaise with stakeholders in laboratories internationally with consultant support, competent with Excel, **Desirable:** ability to develop teaching material for SpR colleagues and other medical staff, to develop the database with support **Knowledge:** basic knowledge of genetics and be willing to engage in structured teaching to learn more knowledge of MDT working including with Fetal medicine, recurrent miscarriage and neonatology. **Responsibilities & Accountabilities (in no particular order of priority):** * Communicate with patients and families attending the service (face-to-face, phone, virtual platforms) * Clinical:contribute to clinics including joint clinics with the consultant geneticist as well as with obstetricians in areas including fetal medicine, maternal medicine, recurrent miscarriage etc. Manage a clinical caseload. * Communicate with colleagues in the Prenatal Genetics team and broader professional community: laboratory colleagues, regionally and internationally, along with other specialties at The National Maternity Hospital and all regions covered by the service. * Educational Activities: Present findings of research, audit and clinical practice to large groups of staff or members of the public. Participate in writing for publication in medical/counselling/lay journals. Participate in the teaching of genetics to medical personnel, other health care professionals and members of the public. * Prepare and present scientific articles in clinical and departmental journal clubs. Act as an educational resource for medical and other personnel attached to the clinical genetics team including student and trainee genetic counsellors. However, the individual will not be the named mentor/supervisor of junior colleagues. * Work on the genetics department database and prepare cases for publication under the supervision of the clinical lead. * Co-ordinate complex genetic testing in pregnancy including both known diagnoses and unknown diagnoses, under the supervision of the Clinical geneticist. * To co-ordinate care of genetics patients attending NMH form other hospitals * To co-ordinate samples and liaise with the relevant laboratories * To competently complete genomic test requests and co-ordinate the testing process * To complete letters to patients and other HCP’s which will be co-signed with the clinical geneticist * To follow-up on cases and ensure testing is completed in a timely manner * To contribute to development of the department through education and learning activities, database management and publications. * To collaborate the deep phenotyping clinics with Fetal medicine and take part in those. * To work with the fetal medicine team to organise interventions and scans for genetics patients. **Flexibility:** This post requires a high level of flexibility to ensure the delivery of an effective and efficient service. Therefore, the post holder will be required to demonstrate flexibility on occasion as and when required by their manager. **Please note:** *This post will be offered and remunerated at Pt 1 of the Registrar scale of the HSE as at June 2026.*

title: Front Desk Attendant (40 hours per week)
GPU Performance Engineer (Inference)
description: **Overview** TensorX is a sovereign AI infrastructure platform headquartered in Dublin. We run frontier open-weight large language models on our own NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs in European datacentres, under EU jurisdiction. Customers reach them through a drop-in OpenAI-compatible API. Nothing they send is retained after the request completes. We serve regulated enterprises in finance, healthcare and government as well as developers and AI platforms. We help them adopt AI without compromising on data privacy, compliance or performance. We are looking for multiple GPU Performance Engineers to join our growing engineering team. Reporting to the CTO, you will make each inference engine in our fleet do more work inside its latency target. You will take engine problems from report to fix, patch the open-source engines we depend on and go beneath them to the kernel when the engine is the limit. Our margin depends on one number: how many requests each GPU answers inside a latency target. That is not the same as peak tokens per second on a benchmark. Passengers carried, not miles per hour. Our customers send very long contexts at high concurrency, so the constraint that matters is rarely the one the headline number measures. The serving engines we depend on, SGLang first, are open source and still maturing. We hit their defects early because we run new models on day zero. We patch them, tune them and change the kernel where the engine itself is the limit. A new open-weight model worth serving arrives most weeks and more GPU capacity is going live now. We are an AI-native team. Tools such as Claude Code and Codex are part of our daily workflow and materially accelerate how we build and operate systems. You will work side by side with our Inference Team, who run NVIDIA Dynamo and the serving fleet. You make each worker faster. They make the fleet of workers behave. We hire on evidence of skill, not years of experience. We will hire across multiple levels. One of the seats may suit someone earlier in their career. This is a hands-on individual contributor role spanning engine performance, GPU kernels, model bring-up and cache behaviour. **Responsibilities** * **Engine tickets end to end** - Take engine problems from report to fix. A model runs out of memory at long context, a patch cuts throughput or a new release breaks tool calling. Reproduce it, find the mechanism, test a fix, patch it and roll it out. Then write down what you found. * **Investigation & diagnosis** - Debug across GPU memory, the engine scheduler, the container, the router and the traffic shape. Many of our hardest problems sit where two of these meet. When you raise a problem with the team, bring a read, not a question: what you think it is and why. * **Goodput per GPU** - Goodput is the number of requests each GPU answers inside the latency target. Find where it is being lost, whether in a kernel, the scheduler, the router or a configuration flag. Win it back. Measure every gain on production traffic patterns rather than a synthetic load. * **Engine patches & upstream** - Patch SGLang and vLLM defects on new models. Bake each fix into the image and keep the patch set consistent across the fleet. Where a fix is not specific to us, open the pull request upstream, not just the issue. * **GPU kernels** - When profiling shows an engine kernel is the bottleneck, write or modify it. Examples include Blackwell attention/indexer paths, FP8/FP4 paths and memory-bound decode. Profile before you form an opinion. * **Model bring-up** - Bring up new models on day zero. Run A/B bake-offs across parallelism layouts, KV cache configurations and speculative decoding settings. Test tensor, data and expert parallelism for each model. Give the Inference Team the best layout for each model so they can size the pools. * **Cache behaviour** - Tune prefix caching, KV cache behaviour and KV replication under tensor parallelism inside the engine. Work with the Inference Team on cache-aware routing and contribute to the router code. * **Pre-production gate** - Share the pre-production gate with the Inference Team so no change reaches a customer unmeasured. Run it on your own changes and on every model you bring up. * **Documentation** - Write up every finding as a report someone else can rerun. Explain trade-offs plainly enough for the Inference Team and for customers. Keep a benchmark method that works without you in the room. **Skills & Experience** * Evidence that you can read an inference engine's source to find the mechanism behind a problem rather than only the symptom. A pull request, a write-up or a post-mortem we can check * Solid understanding of GPU architecture and CUDA fundamentals: memory hierarchy, occupancy and what makes a kernel compute-bound or memory-bound * Working knowledge of transformer inference: attention variants (MLA, DSA, GQA), KV cache behaviour, continuous batching and the accuracy impact of quantisation * Proficiency in Python and comfort reading C++ and CUDA * A measure-first habit: one variable per test arm, a pass or fail bar set before you run and a correctness check before you trust a timing * Honest about results, including the ones that did not work out. Losing to a baseline and saying so counts in your favour * A drive to learn. The stack changes every week. We value someone who reads the source over someone who already knows last year's answer * Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) as part of your daily workflow * A clear and concise communicator who thrives in ambiguity and can articulate technical decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences **Nice to Have** * A track record of writing and benchmarking CUDA kernels on Hopper or Blackwell * Upstream contributions to SGLang, vLLM or TensorRT-LLM * Experience with Triton, CUTLASS, CuTe, ThunderKittens or similar kernel tools * Kernel entries in GPU Mode leaderboards, MLSys contests or FlashInfer challenges * Experience profiling memory behaviour and out-of-memory errors on large models * Hands-on time with Blackwell features (tcgen05, TMEM, TMA) * Technical writing in public **Why This Role** * **You work inside the engine.** Many GPU clouds hire performance engineers for cold starts, storage and containers. We hire them to change the engine and the kernel. That is where our margin is. * **The fleet is ours.** Our own NVIDIA B300 GPUs in Dublin and Helsinki. You are not renting time on someone else's cluster. * **The traffic is real.** Long-context, high-concurrency production workloads that break assumptions benchmarks never test. * **The results are real.** Our inference stack answers roughly twice as many requests inside the latency target as a standard configuration. We measured this on the same hardware with the same production traffic patterns. * **The engine is open.** We patch SGLang in production and send the fixes upstream. If there is a paper in the work, we would rather it went out with your name on it. * **The research list is long.** The better the day-to-day is covered, the more time goes on KV cache beyond GPU memory, context parallelism, wide expert parallelism and attention/FFN disaggregation. **Education & Qualifications** * BSc/MSc/PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning or a related technical discipline OR equivalent demonstrable ability **Remuneration** * Highly competitive package, dependent on experience * 25 days paid annual leave * Hybrid working from our centrally located Dublin office, with remote flexibility * Free inference tokens! **\*\*\*\*\*\*\* NO AGENCY ASSISTANCE REQUIRED \*\*\*\*\*\*\***

description: Job Purpose To provide effective, secure ICT support services to our Ireland users and business functions. Level 2 Technical Support and Escalation * Undertake advanced diagnosis and resolution of incidents escalated from Level 1 support or identified through monitoring and operational activity. * Troubleshoot Windows, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Entra ID, endpoint, network, authentication, application and infrastructure issues using appropriate technical and administrative tools. * Analyse logs, alerts, configuration, performance and dependency information to identify root cause or determine the most effective escalation route. * Coordinate with internal technical specialists, system owners, cybersecurity personnel, application teams and external suppliers where third-line or specialist intervention is required. * Create technically complete escalations that include business impact, troubleshooting performed, evidence, timestamps, affected services and current workaround status. * Contribute to problem management, root cause analysis, known-error records, post-incident reviews and permanent corrective actions. * Provide planned out-of-hours, on-call or weekend support where required by operational arrangements. Microsoft 365 Applications and Tenant Administration * Administer and support the Microsoft 365 tenant and associated services in accordance with approved roles, policies and change controls. * Provide administration and Level 1/Level 2 support for Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Apps and related services. * Support mailbox, distribution list, shared mailbox, Teams, SharePoint site, OneDrive, permissions, sharing and collaboration issues. * Monitor Microsoft 365 service health and operational alerts, assess user impact and communicate or escalate appropriately. * Assist with tenant configuration, feature deployment, update readiness, licensing allocation, licence optimisation and service adoption. * Support approved governance controls for guest access, external sharing, application consent, retention, information protection and collaboration. * Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and approved automation tools to improve administration, reporting and repeatability where appropriate. * Create and maintain tenant configuration records, standard operating procedures, support documentation and evidence required for audit or review. Microsoft Entra ID, Identity and Access Management * Administer users, groups, enterprise applications, service principals and assigned administrative roles in Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid identity services. * Support the joiner, mover and leaver lifecycle, ensuring identity and access changes are authorised, accurate, timely and traceable. * Administer and troubleshoot authentication, single sign-on, MFA, self-service password reset, device identity and access issues. * Support implementation, testing and monitoring of Conditional Access policies under approved governance and change control. * Administer user access rights and role assignments associated with RBAC, privileged access and identity governance standards. * Support identity governance activities including access reviews, entitlement reviews, inactive account review and privileged access monitoring. * Monitor identity-related alerts, risky sign-ins and suspicious authentication activity, and escalate or respond in accordance with incident procedures. * Maintain emergency access, administrative account and service account controls in accordance with approved standards. Azure and Cloud Platform Support * Provide operational support for Microsoft Azure services within the responsibilities assigned to the ICT function. * Assist with Azure subscription, resource group, access, policy, monitoring, tagging, cost-awareness and governance activities. * Support Azure-hosted virtual machines, storage, networking, backup, monitoring and related services where deployed. * Apply approved RBAC, security, logging, backup, resilience and configuration standards to cloud resources. * Participate in cloud migrations, service onboarding, technical assurance and operational handover activities. * Investigate cloud service incidents and coordinate escalation to service owners, suppliers or Microsoft support where required. title: IT/OT Systems & Integration Engineer - Operations Systems Support
description: Vacancy Number: 29249 Category: Engineering - Other Job Type: Full-time **Position Description** The Operations Systems Support (OSS) team within ESB Networks' Distribution Markets and System Operations (DMSO) function are seeking to fill the role of Senior IT/Operational Technology (OT) Systems and Integration Engineer. The role of the OSS team is to support and maintain ESB Networks mission critical OT systems enable the monitoring, control, and management of Ireland's electricity distribution network. These include Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA), Electricity Distribution Network Management System (NMS) and Geographic Information System (GIS). These systems support real-time network operations, outage management, fault response, service restoration, and data exchange across multiple business and operational platforms. This role provides a unique opportunity to support capabilities that form part of Ireland's critical national infrastructure. You will work at the forefront of Operational Technology, supporting the processes that underpin transformation of the electricity network as ESB Networks delivers the systems required for increased renewable generation, network flexibility, electrification and the transition to a net-zero future The Senior IT/OT Systems and Integration Engineer is responsible for supporting, maintaining and enhancing ESB Networks’ critical Operational Technology systems, including NMS, SCADA and associated applications. The role ensures these business-critical platforms remain secure, resilient and available to support network operations, outage management and service restoration. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, you will help deliver the technologies that support the ongoing transformation of Ireland’s electricity network. The position involves delivering enhancements to the existing OT systems, supporting system upgrades and patch deployments, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and carrying out data management activities such as housekeeping, environment refreshes, and data integrity maintenance. The Senior IT/OT Systems & Integration Engineer is also responsible for developing and maintaining custom interfaces and integrations between OT systems and ESB or third-party applications ensuring seamless data exchange and operational effectiveness across the organisation. A key element of the role is working with OT vendors, providing oversight across system support and enhancement activities. Responsibilities include reviewing and approving change requests, supporting the implementation of new functionality, coordinating problem resolution, and engaging with vendor support teams at all levels to ensure timely and effective issue management. In addition to technical responsibilities, the role has a strong focus on knowledge management and capability development. The Senior IT/OT Systems & Integration Engineer will also play an important role in mentoring and developing junior team members, promoting knowledge transfer, supporting structured training programmes, and building sustainable technical capability within the Technical Operations team. **Key Responsibilities:** * Support and maintain ESB Networks critical OT systems, including Electricity maintenance and data quality activities, validation, and data refreshes across OT environments. * Support the development and optimisation of advanced Distribution Management System (DMS) capabilities including, Power Flow Analysis, Fault Location, Isolation and Service Restoration (FLISR), Distributed Energy Resource Management Systems (DERMS), Load Forecasting, Network Optimisation. * Contribute to the ongoing evolution of smart network capabilities that support increased renewable generation, electrification and network flexibility. * Delivery of enhancement projects for the existing OT systems, ensuring alignment with operational and strategic objectives. * Work with OT system vendors to ensure issue resolution, review and approve change requests, guide the implementation of new projects including system upgrades and problem resolution activities. * Support testing activities, including system, integration, user acceptance, and regression testing for upgrades, enhancements, operational runbooks to support effective system operation and support * Supervise, mentor, and support junior team members, promoting collaboration, knowledge sharing, and technical skill description: Risk Trader in UKI Risk Team **Location** : Dublin (2 days/hybrid) **Type:** Permanent **Your next move** If you thrive on pace, enjoy taking initiative and are ready to adapt when things change, you’ll feel at home here. Our Benefits package includes; * Self-Development fund * Wellbeing fund * Uncapped holiday allowance * Enhanced pension scheme * Private Medical Insurance * Discretionary annual performance bonus * Invest via the Company Sharesave Scheme [Perm only] * Paid volunteering time per year * Enhanced parental leave Flutter Entertainment ("Flutter") is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, ensuring every candidate can participate fully and fairly. If we are unable to meet a requested adjustment, we will work with you to explore suitable alternatives and ensure a fair and supportive process. Our goal is to enable all individuals to thrive, removing barriers, so they can reach their full potential. **Flutter** Flutter is the world’s #1 online sports betting and gaming operator and home to some of the UK and Ireland’s most recognisable brands, including Paddy Power, Betfair and Sky Bet. Using our unmatched scale, we share ideas, tech and expertise across our brands and locations, turning great thinking into global impact.
